-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	a := [4]float64{1, 2, 3, 4}
	b := [4]float64{5, 6, 7, 8}
	fmt.Println(a + b)
	_ = a.sum()
	_ = a.min()
	_ = a.max()
	_ = a.dot(b)
}
